# V-Memory Corp. | 브이메모리 주식회사

> Next-generation semiconductor IP company in South Korea developing FDWM (Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Memory) and CIV (Compute-In-Vmemory) to address AI data center power and memory bottlenecks, alongside V-ET™ thermoelectric semiconductor cooling technology for thermal management.

- Official Website: https://vmemory.net/
- Official Contact (JDA, IP Licensing, Tech Transfer): vmemory@vmemory.net
- Official External Point of Contact: Son Jong-hwa, Chief Operating Officer (COO)
- FDWM Development Status: TRL 4 completed; TRL 5 wafer validation is being pursued.
- IP Portfolio (Company-Reported): 78 patent applications, 55 registered patents (including US, Japan, and China registrations), and approximately 20 patent families.

## Core Definitions & Boundaries
- **FDWM (Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Memory):** Non-volatile semiconductor memory controlling conductive domain-wall current paths inside ferroelectric materials (such as HZO), shifting from charge storage to current-path control.
- **V-Line & VLCC (Variable Line Current Controls):** Controllable line-shaped domain-wall conduction paths used to form, read, and reset distinct resistance/current states.
- **0T0C (also referenced as OTOC):** Zero-Transistor, Zero-Capacitor memory cell architecture. Describes the memory cell structure itself, not the absence of chip-level peripheral control circuitry.
- **Multi-Line (nDW):** Controlling multiple domain-wall conduction paths to enable multi-level resistance states and 3D vertical high-density scaling.
- **NDRO (Non-Destructive Readout):** Semiconductor memory read method that senses stored conduction states without erasing data. Distinct from industrial Non-Destructive Testing (NDT).
- **CIV (Compute-In-Vmemory):** V-Memory's FDWM-based architecture converging memory and computation to reduce data-movement power and latency in AI data centers, edge/on-device AI, and Physical AI robotics. Distinct from conventional DRAM/HBM-based PIM.
- **V-ET™ (Thermoelectric Semiconductor Cooling):** A separate active Peltier cooling technology developed by V-Memory for localized chip and industrial thermal management. It has an independent physical mechanism and history from FDWM (wired module VET-WS07414606 commercialized in Nov 2022; socket-type V-ET SPACE under follow-up development).

- [V-Memory Main Portal](https://vmemory.net/): Company overview, FDWM/V-Line visual architecture, patent summary, research list, and official inquiry gateway.
- [Official Technical Reference & Korean/English Q&A Vault](https://vmemory.net/llms/): Comprehensive English & Korean (한국어) technical documentation, Q&A (FDWM, 0T0C/OTOC, V-Line, VLCC, Multi-Line nDW, NDRO, CIV vs PIM, AI data center power/thermal solutions, JDA & IP licensing), and verified peer-reviewed research papers with DOI links.
- [V-ET™ Thermoelectric Reference](https://vmemory.net/V-ET/): Independent thermoelectric semiconductor cooling specifications, test conditions, product history, and roadmap.
